notes: Recall/precision checklist for evaluating extraction quality, not
an exact-match target -- a correct extraction phrases each
requirement differently from source.quote below.
source.spans marks the tender.txt offsets a requirement originates
from; source.quote is those spans' text, joined with ' ... ' when
there is more than one span (used when the requirement's meaning
depends on non-contiguous text, e.g. a shared lead-in clause plus
one enumerated item).
Exhaustive over bidder-facing, pre-award requirements in
tender.txt: both text-verifiable ones (is_text_verifiable: true)
and ones that describe an action or event rather than application
content (is_text_verifiable: false, e.g.
submission_deadline_and_channel). The report should still show the
bidder the false ones, just without a compliant/non_compliant
verdict attached.
No excluded_clauses list: text that is not a bidder requirement at
all (government process/evaluation instructions, post-award
clauses, bare clause titles with no substantive content) is simply
absent here; a predicted requirement that quotes it shows up as
'unexplained' in the precision section.
Several requirements restate verbatim or near-verbatim two or
three times across tender.txt (SAM registration, UEI, price
schedule, 'or equal' documentation, capabilities statement). Each
topic anchors ONE occurrence; a correct pipeline deduplicates the
restatements into one Requirement, so matching its citation set
against this one anchor is sufficient.
small_business_size_standard anchors the sentence with the
concrete NAICS code / dollar size standard, not the other
restatements, which never state that criterion.
no_unpaid_federal_tax_liability and no_recent_felony_conviction
each use two spans: a shared lead-in clause plus the specific
enumerated condition, since the lead-in is shared by both
conditions in one sentence. The lead-in span has
used_for_matching: false, since both topics share its exact
offsets -- without this, a predicted citation covering only the
lead-in plus one condition would match BOTH topics at once.
is_text_verifiable is true only when the tender itself instructs
the bidder to write/represent something specific in their
submission (a checkbox, a required statement, a document to
attach). sam_registration_active is false: the tender states a
plain eligibility fact with no instruction to represent it in the
quote text, unlike no_unpaid_federal_tax_liability/
no_recent_felony_conviction, which have an explicit '(b) The
Offeror represents that--' checkbox right after them.
prior_experience_count.is_mandatory is set true (anchored to the
CHECKLIST FOR QUOTE SUBMITTAL wording), even though a later
section softens it to 'preferably a minimum of 3' -- the tender
itself is internally inconsistent here.
contractor_core_data covers the whole '(c) Contractor Core Data'
fill-in block as one topic, not per-field, since it is one
contiguous form with no independent pass/fail meaning per field.
prior_experience_count and contractor_core_data have no verb of
their own (a bare noun phrase and a bare form-field list); both
use the shared lead-in span 'Offers shall submit the following
information in its entirety:' (used_for_matching: false) as their
governing obligation, since that is the actual imperative these
two enumerations are the object of.

requirements.description: Must be a small business under NAICS 238990 with a size standard of $19M average annual revenue.

source.quote:
This requirement is a 100% total small business set-aside. The associated NAICS code is
238990. The small business size standard is $19 M.

requirements.description: Company must obtain and provide a Unique Entity Identifier (UEI).

source.quote: To be considered for award your company must obtain a Unique Entity Identifier (UEI).

requirements.description: SAM registration must be active at quote close, at award, and throughout contract performance, no exceptions.

source.quote: This registration must be "active" in SAM. NO EXCEPTIONS.

requirements.description: Company must not have any unpaid Federal tax liability that has been assessed and for which all remedies have been exhausted (narrow exceptions apply only if the awarding agency has already considered and waived suspension/debarment); attested via self-representation in the application.

source.quote:
the Government will not enter into a contract with any
corporation that-- ... Has any unpaid Federal tax liability that has been assessed, for which all judicial and
administrative remedies have been exhausted or have lapsed, and that is not being paid in a
timely manner pursuant to an agreement with the authority responsible for collecting the tax
liability, where the awarding agency is aware of the unpaid tax liability, unless an agency has
considered suspension or debarment of the corporation and made a determination that
suspension or debarment is not necessary to protect the interests of the Government; or

requirements.description: Company must not have been convicted of a Federal felony criminal violation within the preceding 24 months (narrow exceptions apply only if the awarding agency has already considered and waived suspension/debarment); attested via self-representation in the application.

source.quote:
the Government will not enter into a contract with any
corporation that-- ... Was convicted of a felony criminal violation under any Federal law within the preceding 24
months, where the awarding agency is aware of the conviction, unless an agency has considered
suspension or debarment of the corporation and made a determination that this action is not
necessary to protect the interests of the Government.

requirements.description: Offeror must complete the attached Price Schedule in its entirety, unedited except for units/quantities, no alternates.

source.quote:
Complete attached Price Schedule and insert total unit price and/or amount, in reference to
ALL line items listed.

requirements.description: The Price Schedule template must not be edited except to add units of measure/quantities; if changes are needed, an addendum explaining them must be provided alongside the unedited schedule.

source.quote:
Must ensure that this document is not edited for any reason (outside of
adding units of measure, quantities, etc.) and the unedited Price Schedule is provided with
final pricing - if needing to make edits or alter the document, provide an addendum outlining
these changes or additional information wanting to make apparent to the evaluators.

requirements.description: If quoting an "or equal" item, must submit detailed product specification/literature confirming comparability.

source.quote:
if quoting an "or equal" item, must submit a
detailed product specifications document/literature and ensure it is provided to confirm the
item(s) are comparable.

requirements.description: Must provide a detailed capabilities statement or project narrative demonstrating how the company will successfully meet the needs of the statement of work.

source.quote:
Provide a detailed capabilities statement or project narrative that demonstrates how the
  company will successfully meet the needs of the statement of work per the "TO SUBMIT AN
  OFFER" section below.

requirements.description: Must include all required shop drawings and product data as part of the technical submission.

source.quote: MUST include all required shop drawings and product data.

requirements.description: Must provide at least 3 prior experience references for projects similar in size and scope, completed within the past 5 years.

source.quote:
Offers shall submit the following information in its entirety: ... Three prior experiences of projects in similar size and scope per the "TO SUBMIT AN
  OFFER" section below within the past five years

requirements.description: Each prior experience reference must include a project description and point-of-contact information.

source.quote:
NOTE: Contact information SHALL be provided, to include a
  brief description of the project, as well as point of contact information

requirements.description: If SAM.gov shows a posted amendment, the offeror must acknowledge it by signing the SF30 and provide it with the final quote/proposal package.

source.quote:
NOTE: Please check SAM.gov regularly in any case an amendment was posted, as this
amendment must be reviewed, acknowledged by signing the SF30 and ensuring that it is
provided with your final quote/proposal package.

requirements.description: Must submit all required documents via email so as to reach the government office by the specified deadline; late submissions will not be accepted.

source.quote:
Submit all required documents via email by the date and time listed in this solicitation.
Offerors are responsible for submitting quotes/proposals so as to reach the Government office
designated in the solicitation by the time specified in the solicitation. Late quotes/proposals will
not be accepted.

requirements.description: Must provide contractor core data: company name, Cage Code / UEI, point of contact, and POC email/phone.

source.quote:
Offers shall submit the following information in its entirety: ... c) Contractor Core Data:
Offerors Company Name:
Cage Code / Offerors Unique Entity Identifier (UEI):
Offerors POC:
Offerors POC Email/Phone:

requirements.description: Must provide a single final offer total, as this is the price that will be evaluated; alternate quotes/proposals will not be accepted.

source.quote:
NOTE: Alternate quotes/proposals will not be accepted. Provide us with the final offer total,
as this will be the evaluated price.
